title: Unordered Set Bucket Interface

title: Unordered Set Load Factor Tuning
explanation: Lower max_load_factor reduces collisions but increases memory. Higher values save memory but may slow lookups.
code:
ust.max_load_factor(0.75);  // Default, balanced
ust.max_load_factor(0.5);   // Faster lookups, more memory
ust.max_load_factor(1.0);   // Less memory, more collisions

title: Unordered Set Extract C++17

explanation: Extracts a node handle, allowing modification and transfer between hash sets without copying.

title: Unordered Set Merge C++17
explanation: Transfers all non-duplicate elements from one unordered_set to another without copying.

title: Unordered Set With String Keys
explanation: unordered_set with string keys is ideal for fast duplicate detection and membership queries.

title: Unordered_Set Clear Frees Memory
explanation: clear() removes elements but does not necessarily free the bucket array (memory stays reserved).

title: Unordered Set Intersection
description: Find common elements between two hash sets
explanation: Iterate the smaller set and check membership in the larger one for efficient intersection.
